atoms.text: Fables, folktales, and myths are stories passed down from generation to generation, often through spoken word. They reveal the values and morals of a certain culture or people. Fables usually feature animals, while folktales are most often about people. Myths are stories that help explain the world around us, including how the world was created and what happens after we die.

atoms.text: While stories often speak about the cultures from which they come, the lessons and morals contained within these tales can be found all around the world. We can learn a lot from the fables, folklore and myths of other cultures, and at the same time apply these lessons to our own lives.

Learn from the failures of others.
My shoes are looking a bit dirty.
